description:
CARPARK AREA	

G1/72,73,74,75	Lime (Tilia x europa)	4 x trees - Re-Pollard back to previous pollard points removing approximately 2-4m of new growth.
                                Final height 4.5m and spread 2.5m.


NORTH WEST CORNER OF SITE 	

T2/38 False Acacia (Robinia Pseudoacacia) - Remove central stem down to fork at 3m. Reduce the height of the remainder of the crown by 4m. and the radius by 1-2m. Final height = 9m and final spread by 4m.

T3/48	Horse Chestnut (Aesculus hippocastanum)	Reduce height by 4m. Reduce remaining crown by 1-2m to shape.
                Final height 7m. Final spread 6m. 

EAST OF CHURCH	

T4/25	Sycamore (Acer pseudoplatanus)	Reduce crown to the most recent previous reduction points, removing approx. 4-5m of new growth.
                Final height 10m and final overall spread 8m.

EAST AND SOUTHERN BOUNDARY	

G5/53,57,58,59,12,13,14,15,16,18,19,20,21,22,23,24	Lime (Tilia x europa)	Approx 16 x trees - Re-Pollard back to previous pollard points removing
               approximately 2-4m of new growth. Final heights 5-10m and spread 4-8m.
